_comment: Quick-reply phrase bank. 'phrases' holds the English source lines. 'translations' is a cache keyed by language code then English phrase; entries are auto-filled by NLLB on first use and can be manually corrected/vetted by a native speaker - manual edits are never overwritten.
phrases: Please wait, a doctor will see you shortly.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Have you taken any medicine for this already?
We need to take a blood sample for testing.
We need to check your temperature and blood pressure.
Do you have any allergies or ongoing illnesses?
Please follow me to the examination room.
You are safe here, we will take care of you.
Do you have someone with you who can help translate?

sw.Please wait, a doctor will see you short: Tafadhali subiri, daktari atakuona hivi karibuni.
sw.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Je, tayari umepata dawa yoyote ya kuondoa ugonjwa huo?
sw.We need to take a blood sample for testi: Tunahitaji kuchukua sampuli ya damu kwa ajili ya mtihani.
sw.We need to check your temperature and bl: Tunahitaji kuangalia joto na shinikizo lako la damu.
sw.Do you have any allergies or ongoing ill: Je, una allergies au ugonjwa unaoendelea?
sw.Please follow me to the examination room: Tafadhali nifuate hadi kwenye chumba cha uchunguzi.
sw.You are safe here, we will take care of: Wewe ni salama hapa, sisi kutunza wewe.
sw.Do you have someone with you who can hel: Je, una mtu yeyote pamoja nawe ambaye anaweza kusaidia kutafsiri?

rw.How long have you been feeling this way?: Ese umaze igihe kingana iki wumva umeze utyo?
rw.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Ese waba waramaze gufata imiti yo kubigeraho?
rw.We need to take a blood sample for testi: Tugomba gufata ibipimo by'amaraso kugira ngo tugeragezwe.
rw.We need to check your temperature and bl: Tugomba kugenzura ubushyuhe n'umuvuduko w'amaraso wawe.
rw.Do you have any allergies or ongoing ill: Ese ufite allergie cyangwa indwara zikuremereye?
rw.Please follow me to the examination room: Ndakwinginze unkurikire ugere mu cyumba cy'imibonano mpuzabitsina.
rw.Do you have someone with you who can hel: Ese ufite umuntu ushobora kugufasha guhindura?

zu.How long have you been feeling this way?: Sekuphele isikhathi esingakanani uzizwa ngale ndlela?
zu.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Ingabe usuvele uthatha imithi yokwelapha lokhu?
zu.We need to take a blood sample for testi: Sidinga ukuthatha isampula legazi ukuze silinge.
zu.We need to check your temperature and bl: Sidinga ukuhlola izinga lokushisa nengcindezi yegazi yakho.

wo.Please wait, a doctor will see you short: Yal na xeex, doktoor dina la gis ci lu yàgg.
wo.Where exactly does it hurt?: Foofa tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax tax?
wo.How long have you been feeling this way?: Lu yàgg nga ngi feel nii?
wo.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Ndax nga jël dara ci wii xëtu?
wo.We need to take a blood sample for testi: Nu war na jël ay xarab yu deret ngir seet.
wo.We need to check your temperature and bl: Nu war na seet sa temperatura ak sa xeex.
wo.Do you have any allergies or ongoing ill: Ndax am na la ay xarit mbaa ay jàngoro yu tollu?
wo.Please follow me to the examination room: Yal na ma topp ci biir kër gi.
wo.You are safe here, we will take care of: Dinaa am njariñ, nu leen di sàmm.
wo.Do you have someone with you who can hel: Ndax am na kenn ci yaw, mi man a koy wallu?

ig.Please wait, a doctor will see you short: Biko chere, dọkịta ga-ahụ gị n'oge na-adịghị anya.
ig.How long have you been feeling this way?: Kemgbe ole mgbe ka obi na-adị gị otú a?
ig.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Ị̀ ṅụrụ ọgwụ ọ bụla maka nke a?
ig.We need to take a blood sample for testi: Anyị kwesịrị iwere ọbara ka a nwalee ya.
ig.We need to check your temperature and bl: Anyị kwesịrị inyocha ọnọdụ okpomọkụ na ọbara mgbali gị.
ig.Do you have any allergies or ongoing ill: Ì nwere allergies ma ọ bụ ọrịa ọ bụla na-aga n'ihu?
ig.Please follow me to the examination room: Biko soro m gaa n'ọnụ ụlọ nyocha.
ig.You are safe here, we will take care of: Ị ga-adị mma ebe a, anyị ga-elekọta gị.
ig.Do you have someone with you who can hel: Ì nwere onye ga-enyere gị aka ịsụgharị?

af.Please wait, a doctor will see you short: Wag asseblief, 'n dokter sal jou binnekort sien.
af.How long have you been feeling this way?: Hoe lank voel jy al so?
af.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Het jy al medikasie vir hierdie behandeling geneem?
af.We need to take a blood sample for testi: Ons moet 'n bloedmonster neem vir toetsing.
af.We need to check your temperature and bl: Ons moet jou temperatuur en bloeddruk ondersoek.
af.Do you have any allergies or ongoing ill: Het jy allergieë of aanhoudende siektes?
af.Please follow me to the examination room: Volg my asseblief na die eksamenkamer.
af.You are safe here, we will take care of: Jy is veilig hier, ons sal sorg vir jou.
af.Do you have someone with you who can hel: Het jy iemand by jou wat kan help vertaal?

ha.Please wait, a doctor will see you short: Don Allah jira, likita zai gan ka nan da nan.
ha.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Ka riga ka sha magani don wannan?
ha.We need to take a blood sample for testi: Muna bukatar mu dauki samfurin jini don gwaji.
ha.We need to check your temperature and bl: Muna bukatar mu duba zafin jikinka da kuma karfin jini.
ha.Do you have any allergies or ongoing ill: Kana fama da allergies ko kuma rashin lafiya?
ha.Please follow me to the examination room: Don Allah ku bi ni zuwa dakin binciken.
ha.You are safe here, we will take care of: Za ka kasance lafiya a nan, za mu kula da ku.
ha.Do you have someone with you who can hel: Shin kana da wani da zai taimake ka ka fassara?

am.How long have you been feeling this way?: ይህን ስሜት ከሰማህ ምን ያህል ጊዜ ኖረህ ነው?
am.We need to check your temperature and bl: የሙቀት መጠንና የደም ግፊትዎን መመርመር አለብን.
am.Do you have any allergies or ongoing ill: አለርጂ ወይም ቀጣይነት ያለው በሽታ አለዎት?

yo.Please wait, a doctor will see you short: Jọ̀wọ́ dúró, dókítà yóò rí ọ láìpẹ́.
yo.Where exactly does it hurt?: Ibo gan-an ni ó ti ń ṣe é?
yo.How long have you been feeling this way?: Ìgbà wo ni nǹkan yìí ti ń ṣẹlẹ̀ sí ẹ?
yo.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Ṣé o ti lo oògùn kankan fún èyí rí?
yo.We need to take a blood sample for testi: A ní láti gba ẹ̀jẹ̀ fún ìwádìí.
yo.We need to check your temperature and bl: A ní láti ṣàyẹ̀wò òtútù àti ìsoríkọ́ ẹ̀jẹ̀ rẹ.
yo.Do you have any allergies or ongoing ill: Ṣé o ní àìlera tàbí àìlera kan tó ń bá ẹ fínra?
yo.Please follow me to the examination room: Jọwọ tẹ̀ lé mi lọ sí yàrá ìwádìí.
yo.You are safe here, we will take care of: O ní ààbò níbí, a ó bójú tó ọ.
yo.Do you have someone with you who can hel: Ǹjẹ́ o ní ẹnì kan tó lè ràn ẹ́ lọ́wọ́ láti túmọ̀?
